clauses.clause: **No single follower is slower than the group.** While the group moves, every follower's median speed ≥ 0.95× the group median (tune); time the player stands waiting for one follower > 10 m behind ≤ 10 % of escort time (tune). PO: "let me stay with the crowd for suvivor."
clauses.note: Fresh ordinary L7 high seed1 completion: departure followers62/65/74 median/group ratios0.9137348293/0.8780749680/0.8707108993, each with>=10 walking samples and a valid completed route; all are below0.95. The existing majority-of-three vote passes these IDs, but does not erase these concrete violations of the unchanged every-follower criterion. L5 high seed3 follower28 also reaches0.8945363771. L6 exact empty-input waiting is39/16082 ticks=0.242507% at both tiers (canonical final hashes identical), so its48.3% stationary upper bound is not classified as an actual wait failure.
